item.description: Ford Motor Company has announced the appointment of Tim Wels as managing director, Ford Philippines, effective November 1, 2026. Tim is currently general manager, Marketing and Strategy, Ford Australia. He will succeed Pedro Simoes who will be repatriating to the Middle East. Read More »

item.title: Muntinlupa City Gets BYD EVs As New Police Patrol Cars
item.description: The City Government of Muntinlupa is the next municipality to go electrified as BYD Cars Philippines turned over eight battery electric patrol cars. The move strengthens local police operations while advancing Muntinlupa Mayor Ruffy Biazon’s green technology program for the city. Read More »
